items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Well when Kid Ory was down here I don't remember Kid Ory.

ctx.x: I think Kid Ory once had him and his band in place of Henry Martin had been Ory's drummer but he seemed to like Joe Lindsey too I believe if I remember.
Well when Kid Ory was down here I don't remember Kid Ory.
No but I thought maybe Henry, I mean Joe Lindsey might have played quite a while later. You never heard him then in your time?

items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I do believe I would have had a chance to go back and play with Kid Ora if Ake would have let me play the way I wanted to play.

ctx.x: Al VanCote, yeah. Yeah, he's been down here. He came down with Joe Dierensburg one time. Well I didn't see him. No passing through. I would like to see him. I met him up at the Roosevelt's. They were up there. You know Joe, huh? Yeah, I know Joe, yeah. He was up there. They came up to a jazz club meeting. I remember him up there.

About stuff I was up there. Probably I would have got a chance to play with Kid Ora at the time because when we came back he hadn't made contact with Alvin and Alvin went back to play with Kid Ora and I do believe I would have had a chance to go back and play with Kid Ora if Ake would have let me play the way I wanted to play. But that's the play he's style of
playing. Oh yeah. Well now you do play a little more?
